sources.note: Entity designer help page; WebFetch extraction (paraphrase)

claims.statement: The designer can be shown together with other panels, integrated into the standard IDE panels.
claims.supports: integrate it into the standard IDE panels
claims.surfaceEquivalent: plugin.toml declares the designer view in the right panel beside the structure view in the left panel (RS-958). Not checked: host docking and layout.

claims.statement: The designer can be shown as separate panels or hidden altogether.
claims.surfaceEquivalent: Designer sections (palette, inspector, toolbar) each hidden by settings, all hidden together (RS-959). Not checked: closing the designer panel (host function), rendering.

claims.statement: A minimalistic mode exists for small screens.
claims.surfaceEquivalent: Setting jpaAssist.designer.minimalMode hides the palette, property search, General section and source path of the Persistence Designer (designer.rs test, scripts/check-jpa-designer.mjs at 280px). Not checked: host window sizing, other tool windows.

claims.statement: JPA Structure and JPA Inspector visibility is configurable in designer settings.
claims.surfaceEquivalent: Setting jpaAssist.designer.showInspector hides the JPA Inspector of the Persistence Designer (replies carry layout.inspector; the palette and editor toolbar have their own settings). Not checked: JPA Structure visibility (a separate host tool window with no designer setting), the settings page rendering, the hiding itself.
